subject.title: fix(agents): avoid symlink-follow in auth.json bootstrap

question: Should OpenClaw retain the proposed shared `replaceFileAtomic` wrapper for this security fix, or should the no-final-path-chmod and descriptor-mode guarantee be added to and released from `@openclaw/fs-safe` before this PR lands?
rationale: The remaining question is not a routine code correction: it determines the permanent owner of security-sensitive replacement semantics used beyond `auth.json`.

options.title: Move the guarantee upstream
options.body: Add the no-final-path-chmod and exact descriptor-mode behavior to `@openclaw/fs-safe`, release it, and return OpenClaw to a thin dependency delegation path.

options.title: Approve a bounded local wrapper
options.body: Land this wrapper now as an explicitly temporary OpenClaw hardening layer, with a tracked upstreaming/removal plan and shared-caller regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Move the guarantee upstream
recommendation.body: Add the no-final-path-chmod and exact descriptor-mode behavior to `@openclaw/fs-safe`, release it, and return OpenClaw to a thin dependency delegation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion explicitly asks this security group to choose the permanent ownership boundary.
